# Re-login and fetch alarms, then update the 'Go to sleep' alarm and disable the rest.

login = apis.phone.login(username='4436271690', password='1YEfc]J')
access_token = login['access_token']

# Fetch all alarms (paginated)
api = apis.phone
alarms = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = api.show_alarms(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    alarms.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

print('alarms found:', len(alarms))
for a in alarms:
    print(a['alarm_id'], a['label'], a['time'], 'enabled=', a['enabled'])

# Identify go-to-sleep alarm (label contains 'Go to sleep')
go_to_sleep = [a for a in alarms if a.get('label','').lower() == 'go to sleep' or 'go to sleep' in a.get('label','').lower()]
print('go_to_sleep candidates:', [(a['alarm_id'], a['time'], a['enabled']) for a in go_to_sleep])

assert len(go_to_sleep) == 1, f"Expected exactly 1 go-to-sleep alarm, found {len(go_to_sleep)}"
go = go_to_sleep[0]

def shift_time_1_hour(hhmm):
    hh, mm = hhmm.split(':')
    hh_i = int(hh)
    mm_i = int(mm)
    hh_new = (hh_i + 1) % 24
    return f"{hh_new:02d}:{mm_i:02d}"

new_time = shift_time_1_hour(go['time'])
print('go-to-sleep alarm_id:', go['alarm_id'], 'old time:', go['time'], 'new time:', new_time)

# Target set for disable = all other alarms
other_alarm_ids = [a['alarm_id'] for a in alarms if a['alarm_id'] != go['alarm_id']]
print('disable other alarm ids:', other_alarm_ids, 'count:', len(other_alarm_ids))

# Update go-to-sleep alarm time (keep enabled true)
res1 = api.update_alarm(alarm_id=go['alarm_id'], access_token=access_token, time=new_time, enabled=True)
print('update go-to-sleep result:', res1)

# Disable all other alarms
results = []
for alarm_id in other_alarm_ids:
    r = api.update_alarm(alarm_id=alarm_id, access_token=access_token, enabled=False)
    results.append((alarm_id, r))
print('disable results:', results)
